sources.entry: MacOSCleaner - Free, open-source macOS cleaner with disk analyzer, app uninstaller, and smart cleanup. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/AlexTkDev/MacOSCleaner) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A free, native, privacy-focused cleaner and application uninstaller for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26, built in Swift 6 and SwiftUI, with disk analysis and duplicate finding.
summary.what_it_does: Scans and cleans macOS caches, logs, browser data, and developer toolchain caches (Xcode, Docker, Python, Node, Rust, Go and others) across 55+ categories, with review-only categories deselected by default. The app uninstaller inspects bundle IDs, team IDs, Spotlight metadata and Launch Services records to find leftover files, and runs a soft quit, launchd helper bootout, then trash sequence. A duplicate finder uses size matching, a 4 KB header checksum and full SHA-256 verification, with Quick Look previews. A disk space analyzer offers folder drill-down with APFS allocated sizes, and a process and service manager shows live CPU and RAM use and lists LaunchAgents, LaunchDaemons and Login Items. The README states that all scanning runs locally with no telemetry, and that uninstalls and duplicates go to Trash rather than being permanently deleted.
use_cases: free up disk space on a mac
uninstall an app and its leftover files
find and remove duplicate photos or files
find large folders eating disk space
clean developer caches like Xcode and Docker
manage startup items and login items
how_to_run: git clone (repository URL in README; placeholder left blank in the text)
Build and run with ⌘R in Xcode, or run tests with ⌘U
Alternatively, download the latest .dmg from GitHub Releases and drag MacOSCleaner.app into /Applications
notable: Forensic uninstaller that checks 30 evidence types across 2,343 cataloged remnant paths, with a 3-stage pipeline
Duplicate finder with a 3-stage detection pipeline (size, 4 KB header checksum, full SHA-256) and a split-view interface
On-device FoundationModels classification of files as safe, caution or danger, with streamed explanations
Siri and App Intents shortcuts for cleaning categories and emptying Trash, requiring authentication
Localized into 14 languages, including Arabic with right-to-left layout
caveats: Requires macOS 26.0 or later and Apple Silicon; Intel Macs are not supported
Building from source needs Xcode 26 and XcodeGen, and public source builds use a fallback cleanup catalog
Unnotarized local builds may trigger a Gatekeeper warning that requires running an xattr command
Commercial use is restricted by the Commons Clause; enterprise or proprietary distribution needs a separate commercial license
